title: Wayfare Pass Membership Terms — Loyalty All Access Discount
content:
# Loyalty All Access discount (Wayfare Pass)

**Clause.** On a move up to Wayfare Pass All Access Annual, the loyalty All Access discount is 10 percent for a member who has held the Wayfare Pass (rider membership) membership for at least 24 whole months and has at least 20 trips charged a fare in the last three months; it is 5 percent for a member who does not meet that tier but has held the membership for at least 12 whole months and has at least 10 such trips; it is nothing for anyone else.

**Effect.** The discount is taken off the All Access upgrade charge as that percentage of the All Access Annual membership fee of 249.00. The percentage is always of the 249.00 fee itself; the amount taken off is not rounded on its own, and the charge is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

## Records read

- **Whole months held**: whole calendar months from the membership's enrollment date to the change date.
- **Trips charged a fare**: fare charges on the member's trips in Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares) dated in the last three months, one per trip.

## Tier table

| Whole months held | Trips charged a fare, last three months | Discount |
|---|---|---|
| 24 or more | 20 or more | 10 percent |
| 24 or more | 10 to 19 | 5 percent |
| 12 to 23 | 10 or more | 5 percent |
| 12 or more | under 10 | nothing |
| under 12 | any | nothing |

## Edges (hypothetical members)

- 24 months, 20 trips: 10 percent; 24 months, 19 trips: 5 percent; 23 months, 25 trips: 5 percent.
- 12 months, 10 trips: 5 percent; 12 months, 9 trips: nothing; 11 months, 40 trips: nothing.

At 10 percent, 24.90 is taken off; at 5 percent, 12.45.
